wargear.name: Sonic Shrieker
wargear.text: All enemy units engaged by this model's unit have their Initiative (I) characteristic reduced to 1.

wargear.name: Dirge Caster
wargear.text: Enemy units have -1 to all hit rolls in the Combat Phase against a model that is equipped with a Dirge Caster.

wargear.name: Warp Amplifier
wargear.text: All enemy units within 18" of a unit with this wargear suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristics.

wargear.name: Combat Drugs
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic and the Frenzy special rule.

wargear.name: Intoxicating Elixir
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains +1 to their Strength (S), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, they gain the Frenzy special rule.

wargear.name: The Endless Grin
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Fear (1) special rule, if they already have the Fear (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

wargear.name: Tears of the Phoenix
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic doubles their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic when attacks are resolved against them or their attached unit.

wargear.name: Armour of Shrieking Souls
wargear.text: This confers a 2+ Armour save. The first time this model is slain and removed from play, it is not and instead remains on the battlefield with no wounds allocated to it.

wargear.name: Daemonic Bike
wargear.text: This unit is equipped with a Bike and is the Bike type, gaining all associated benefits. However, this units Hammer of Wrath Attacks are resolved at AP2. In addition, this unit gains the Fly special rule.

wargear.name: The Gilded Panoply
wargear.datasheet: Fulgrim, Daemon Primarch of the Emperor's Children
wargear.text: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour save. It grants a 4+ Invulnerable save in the Combat Phase.
